Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
To issue driver licenses, C.D.L.’s, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, etc.
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
Informational Materials Available
C.D.L books
Driver license books
Specialty license plate applications
Telephone Numbers
We will accept all major credit cards.
however, there is a charge of 3% on every $100.00

Every Tuesday — Hours 9:45 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. – open during lunch hour
Online Practice Drivers Exam
Motor Vehicle: (402)374-2911
No Driving Tests given after 3:30 p.m.
